lede: Every Framer plan, what each AI credit tier costs, and the cheapest plan for how much you use Framer AI.
calc_label: Framer AI credits you need each month
calc_note: The calculator uses Framer's credit options: Basic with 1,000 or 2,000 credits, then Pro from 3,000 to 100,000. From 3,000 to 15,000 credits, Basic and Pro cost the same on Framer's page, and Pro includes more, so the calculator picks Pro. Agents and other AI features use credits.
after_plans: Prices on the cards are for the smallest credit option of each plan, in US dollars, plus tax. Basic also comes with 3,000 to 15,000 credits at the same price as Pro. Additional editors are $30/month, or $20/month billed yearly, and viewers are free. Framer includes a complimentary domain on yearly billing.

compare.Free plan: Free: Framer domain, 500 AI credits, 1 GB bandwidth
compare.Cheapest paid plan: Basic: $15/month, or $10/month billed yearly, with 1,000 AI credits
compare.Largest public plan: Pro with 100,000 credits: $1,500/month, or $1,000/month billed yearly
compare.Yearly billing: Lower price and a complimentary domain
compare.Extra team members: Editors $30/month, or $20/month billed yearly; viewers free

faq: Framer Basic costs $15/month, or $10/month billed yearly, with 1,000 AI credits. Pro costs $45/month, or $30/month billed yearly, with 3,000 credits, and goes up to $1,500/month ($1,000/month yearly) for 100,000 credits. Enterprise is custom.
Yes. The Free plan includes 500 AI credits a month, a free Framer domain and 1 GB of bandwidth. Framer describes it as ideal for non-commercial use. A custom domain needs a paid plan.
Framer says every paid plan includes monthly credits that power Agents, Localization and other AI features. Credits are shared across the workspace and its editors.
At 3,000 to 15,000 credits a month, Basic and Pro cost the same. Pro adds more pages, CMS collections and bandwidth, plus site redirects, staging and branching.
